text:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High rate of container restarts on prod-gpu-pool-3 (model-serving). Observed: repeated OOM during prefill for large-context requests. Start time: 2026-03-16 22:12:14 UTC. Paging oncall.

jamie_oncall: on it. seeing ~15 restarts in last 10m across 3 nodes. looks correlated with long-prompt traces.

devon_infra: thx. can you paste kernel/OOM logs? I want to see if it's prefill or generation phase.

jamie_oncall: quick log snippet: ```
Mar 16 22:11:58 node-3 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 4821 (containerd-shim) total-vm:6144000kB, anon-rss:4012340kB
Mar 16 22:12:00 runtime: cuda driver err: CUDARuntime(9) - out of memory
Container restart reason: SIGKILL (OOM)
Model: redwood-7b-v2, seq_len: 16384, prefill_tokens: 12000
```

maria_ml: that model's KV cache + prefill size at that seq looks like the obvious cause. customers hitting large-context prompt sets. can we temporarily route those requests to a coldmodel (quantized lower-memory variant)?

kevin_sre: we can set a routing fallback policy to redwood-7b-q4f-coldmodel for the affected region. will need a quick rollout. deploy_bot, can you apply route rule for traffic from prod-gpu-pool-3?

deploy_bot: Applying route change: redirect 30% of traffic matching predicate (seq_len > 8192 OR header x-app-large-context: true) to redwood-7b-q4f-coldmodel in us-west-2. Started at 22:17:05 UTC.

devon_infra: I'll cordon node-3 and drain containers after traffic shift stabilizes. evict policy set to graceful with 60s wait.

jamie_oncall: running a quick live mitigation: reduce max_prefill_tokens to 8k on the serving config for redwood-7b-v2 to prevent huge prefill allocations. patch applied at 22:19:12 UTC.

olivia_support: preparing customer comms. Suggested text: "We detected elevated memory pressure on some GPU hosts causing inference retries for very large context requests. We’ve applied temporary routing and limits to reduce impact while we investigate. No data loss. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause." ok to send as incident update? :white_check_mark:

maria_ml: also enabling prefix/KV caching for warm sessions may reduce duplicate prefill on repeated long prompts. Will open a follow-up task to evaluate aggressive KV eviction heuristics.

kevin_sre: observed restart rate dropping to 2 in last 5m after route + config changes. node-3 still has 1 flapper but not fully crashing.

jamie_oncall: confirm prod traffic latency spike for those routed requests is +120ms but success rate improved. marking as "mitigated" for pager.

incident_bot: Incident status: MITIGATED. Mitigation summary: traffic routing to coldmodel + max_prefill_tokens reduction + node cordon/drain. Next steps: postmortem, long-term config to reject/trim >12k prefill, add reactive autoscaling for prefill spikes.

devon_infra: I'll keep node-3 cordoned and schedule a hardware check. assigning follow-up: infra#1421.

jamie_oncall: thanks everyone. action items: maria to evaluate KV caching (owner: maria_ml), devon to investigate node flaps (owner: devon_infra), kevin to draft incident timeline (owner: kevin_sre). I'll draft the customer update and postmortem template.

olivia_support: posting first-customer-update now. tag me when you have the final timeline.

kevin_sre: saving logs/trace: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/3011122334/ for RCA.

jamie_oncall: closing pager. if we see regressions re-open. :thumbsup:
